items.description: iDatam is an infrastructure provider of bare-metal/dedicated servers (GPU, storage, colocation, gaming-optimized hardware) aimed at enterprises, gaming networks and AI researchers, avoiding the resource contention of shared/virtualized hosting
All dedicated servers overview page listing the full range of dedicated hosting

Game server hosting pages per game or use (Minecraft, Rust, Counter-Strike, game development & rendering)
